pages.text: By infusing animal hide with materials connected to the Primordial Ocean, I have designed a set of arcane garb that will enhance the power of any wand I am holding.$(br2)Yes, I'm fully aware of its... undignified... appearance. The form of a dolphin is simply the form with the greatest resonance to the Primordial Ocean.
...It does not matter. If it will bring me closer to my goal, I will wear whatever ridiculous costume this world forces upon me.
